title: Divergence: proof-backends.md REQ-9/§7 misstates mutation_score's SHIPPED kill semantics (Timeout counts as KILLED today, not Refuted-only) and leaves the floor-vs-shrunken-denominator rule undecided

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Code: check.rs mutation_score step 3 — 'a Proved mutant SURVIVED; a Counterexample / Timeout mutant is KILLED'; mutant_outcome_is_survivor = matches!(Proved); mutation.rs REQ-4 'Killed (counterexample / timeout)'. The doc claims its rule is 'exactly today's mutant_outcome_is_survivor inverted, but now over Verdict::Refuted' — false: inverted-survivor = Refuted UNION Unknown. Restricting kills to Refuted reclassifies every Timeout-killed mutant as 'untested'/dropped — a semantics CHANGE to the shipped battery presented as a faithful generalization, and the OQ-5 cite covers only lowering failures (timeouts are NOT dropped today). Undecided consequence the doc must rule on: with untested mutants dropped from the denominator, an item passes MUTATION_FLOOR (meets_floor, 0.60) at 1 killed / 1 tested with N mutants untested — '§7 floor unchanged' is asserted without a minimum-tested rule or untested-counts-as-unkilled decision (the scored==0 -> below-floor backstop covers only the all-untested case). Correction: state the shipped Timeout=KILLED semantics accurately, mark the Refuted-only kill definition as a deliberate change with rationale, and decide the floor denominator rule.
